---

## Datacenter or route

Example: DC6 CN2 GIA-E, Hong Kong CN2 GIA, Tokyo CN2 GIA.

## What changed?

- [ ] New public test target
- [ ] Existing target no longer responds
- [ ] Documentation wording is outdated
- [ ] Other

## Evidence

Please include public source links, command output, or enough context to verify the change.

## Notes

Do not include account screenshots, private order details, API keys, tokens or credentials.
